features.name: share_comments_opening_with_argument_reference
features.definition: What proportion of counter-argument comments open with the literal phrases 'Your argument', 'The argument' or 'Consider'?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings (malformed/missing -> null). Empty list -> null. For each comment, take the string, strip leading whitespace and leading quote/markdown characters (>, *, _, ", ') and match case-insensitively with regex r'^(your argument|the argument|consider)\b'. Output = number of matching comments / total number of comments (0 to 1). Mechanical literal matching only; no semantic filtering, so comments mentioning outcomes are not excluded.

h1: Higher share_comments_opening_with_argument_reference is associated with higher likelihood of delta (OP view change).
note: Operationalized "open with direct reference to the OP's argument" as the three literal example openers only; other direct references (e.g. "You say", "OP's claim") are missed. Persuasiveness is measured by the dataset outcome delta, an association not causal. Row-level share of comments; comment order and individual comment outcomes are unavailable, so it does not show that the opening comment was the persuasive one. Raw text may contain outcome announcements; not filtered. Possible opening quotations of OP text are stripped only for quote markers.
